rulings.restated: Choose — [helper "Taking the EIC on Form 1040, line 27a" = true → helper "Earned Income Chart, taking the EIC: Worksheet B, line 4b, or the earned income from Step 5"] [helper "Taking the EIC on Form 1040, line 27a" = false → helper "Earned Income Worksheet, line 7, the amount for line 18a of Schedule 8812 (zero when line 3 is zero or less)"]
rulings.model: For filers taking the EIC, the restatement always uses EIC Worksheet B line 4b or the Step 5 earned income. The Earned Income Chart instead says that filers who "use either optional method to figure those net earnings" enter "the amount figured using the Earned Income Worksheet next (even if you are also taking the EIC)", and no refusal covers that case. The EIC branch also omits the chart's clergy subtractions, which are not refused on that path.
rulings.ruling: Ruling: refusal located elsewhere; restatement accepted. The optional methods are refused through person.se_screen ('electing an optional method (Schedule SE Part II)'), so the Earned Income Chart's optional-method row never applies; the clergy subtractions apply to a member of the clergy, refused through scope.schedule1 and person.se_screen ('being a minister ...'). Otherwise the restatement is the chart (i1040s8812 p. 7), with the Earned Income Worksheet's stop at line 3 since BUG-0055.
